replaces.idea: A short iron picket fence bolted to a baseplate with a central clasp, representing the SMM TSEG memory boundary.
A round wall-mounted pressure gauge with its needle frozen at the redline, representing a frozen CPU thermal-throttle state.
A freestanding wooden pegboard with numbered hooks, representing an SMI handler jump table.
A wall-mounted toggle latch on a backplate with its lever snapped into the locked-down notch, representing an SMI# pin-assertion latch.
A thick bound ledger lying flat on a stand with a metal corner-clasp holding it shut, representing the saved-state SMRAM map.

new.name: TSEG Barricade
new.concept: SMM TSEG (Top Segment) protected memory boundary
new.depicts: A short iron picket fence with three vertical posts bolted to a flat baseplate and a horizontal crossbar.
new.focal: A heavy clasp bolted across the center rail.

new.name: SMI Pin Latch
new.concept: SMI# pin assertion and hardware latch
new.depicts: A wall-mounted toggle latch on a rectangular backplate with a spring-loaded lever.
new.focal: The lever snapped into the locked-down notch.

new.name: SMRAM Ledger
new.depicts: A small thick bound ledger lying flat on a stand with a ribbon bookmark sticking out.
new.focal: A metal corner-clasp holding the cover shut.

rework.redesign: Redraw the coin standing on edge inside a small slotted coin-stand so it is at least 8 px wide and grounded on a base.
Redraw the feather resting on a small stone plinth or caught in a downward-tilted fall with a clear ground shadow-line beneath it.
Replace the free-floating sparkle glyph with a small brass-style spark-gap post mounted on a ceramic baseplate.
